lifecycle_contract.output_bound: LZ4F_compressBound plus header/finalize allowance; conservative upper bound
lifecycle_contract.return_length: Every update/finalize call returns actual used bytes
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: Stable tscb_status_v1 maps native LZ4F errors

stream_components.outer_container: TSCB versioned descriptor prefix and canonical JSON metadata
stream_components.frame_header: LZ4 frame magic, FLG, BD, content size, header checksum
stream_components.blocks: LZ4 block headers and compressed or raw-fallback block payloads
stream_components.footer: End mark and optional content checksum
stream_components.accounting: Exact structural inspection; no capacity bytes are charged

known_limitations: The lzbench benchmark table itself exercises the raw LZ4 block API; this adapter uses the complete LZ4 frame implementation vendored by the same benchmark.
The project wrapper currently performs one update per independently finalized object and does not claim streaming/query capability.
The Python FFI descriptor serialization and contiguous byte materialization are included in the declared adapter boundary.
LeakSanitizer cannot run under the host container ptrace policy; ASan/UBSan qualification ran with detect_leaks=0.
